# Suppress Leading Zero.

Suppress leading zero of numbers.

## Usage

``` r
suppressLeadingZero(value)
```

## Arguments

- value:

  Numeric vector.

## Value

Character vector of numbers without leading zeros.

## Details

\[INSERT\].

## See also

Other formatting:
[`apa()`](https://devpsylab.github.io/petersenlab/reference/apa.md),
[`pValue()`](https://devpsylab.github.io/petersenlab/reference/pValue.md),
[`specify_decimal()`](https://devpsylab.github.io/petersenlab/reference/specify_decimal.md)

## Examples

``` r
# Prepare Data
v1 <- rnorm(1000)

# Suppress Leading Zero
suppressLeadingZero(v1)
```
